title: Establish a portfolio-wide ESG-risk control
assumptions: The material SME portfolio is managed through the stated credit-risk processes.
source_basis: Scenario gap is synthetic; control-accountability model is calibrated to the publicly disclosed three-lines model.
closure_criteria: Approved control is operating across the SME portfolio and has passed a documented effectiveness test.

title: Remediate ESG data coverage for material SME exposures
assumptions: Missing ESG fields can be sourced or derived subject to data-governance approval.
source_basis: Scenario gap is synthetic; internal unit cost is calibrated to published 2025 personnel expense and FTE.
closure_criteria: Data profile evidences agreed coverage threshold and recurring quality monitoring is live.

title: Implement Verification of Payee in mobile banking
assumptions: The existing web Verification of Payee vendor interface can be reused for mobile.
source_basis: Channel gap and vendor price are synthetic; ICT change evidence is calibrated to the reference ICT change-management framework.
closure_criteria: Production mobile payments invoke Verification of Payee and release, testing, and vendor-SLA evidence are approved.

title: Complete critical-service and third-party dependency mapping
assumptions: The CMDB and vendor-risk portal contain enough source records to reconcile the initial map.
source_basis: Scenario incompleteness is synthetic; BIA, dependency mapping, third-party oversight and recovery evidence are reference-calibrated.
closure_criteria: Every critical service has an approved dependency map with systems, supporting vendors, owners, and review date.

title: Document limited FRTB applicability and establish annual trigger review
assumptions: There is no material trading desk or internal market-risk model at assessment date.
source_basis: Limited applicability is synthetic; first-line Treasury execution and second-line Financial Risk challenge are reference-calibrated.
closure_criteria: Approved applicability memo is stored and annual review triggers are assigned to Treasury.
